thread:
linda_cs: Customer ticket #5421 — free trial blocked by fraud checks. Customer says they used promo code 'LAUNCH50' during signup but got 'trial_on_hold' error. They sign up from a mobile carrier with rotating IPs and used gmail alias (+work). Card was attempted but declined by provider. Customer provided order id ORD-8899 and email customer.jade+work@gmail.com. Asking if we can manually grant trial while risk investigates.

sara_support: Thanks Linda — can you paste the backend alert payload or screenshot? Need reason code from the fraud service (vpn/device/reuse). Also what's the acct id?

linda_cs: Pasting redacted alert.

```
risk_bot_alert: rule_trigger=ip_velocity; score=78; indicators=[ip_rotation, device_mismatch]; email_type=free_provider_alias
account: acct_009884; card_last4=4242 (auth declined)
promo_code: LAUNCH50
```

sara_support: Ok. Risk bot shows ip_velocity + device mismatch. Devon, any quick option to confirm corporate email or override for trial?

devon_ops: We can do a manual override but we should verify customer identity first. Standard checklist: ask for corporate email OR short screenshot of billing page showing name, or a photo of government ID (if high risk). Since this is a free trial promo, lower barrier — if they supply a company domain email we can proceed.

linda_cs: Customer replied: "i can use my work email (jade@aurora-labs.com) — it's the same org." They're willing to change.

sara_support: Good. Ask them to confirm by signing up with the work email or reply here with a verification screenshot. I'll stand by to run the override once verified.

mike_eng: Heads up — ip_velocity rule is noisy for some APAC mobile carriers where NAT/CGNAT causes ip churn. We're seeing false positives. If this becomes frequent, we should tune signal weights (ip_velocity should be lower weight when email domain verified).

sara_support: Noted. For this thread I'll do a one-off manual grant after verification. Linda, please have them create a new trial using the work email and confirm the last 6 chars of the account id, then drop it here.

linda_cs: Customer completed sign-up with jade@aurora-labs.com and posted acct id acct_009999. Last 6 chars = 009999.

sara_support: Doing manual grant now: `/admin grant_trial --account acct_009999 --promo LAUNCH50 --reason "manual override: verified corporate email"`

```
(admin-tool) => success: trial_granted, trial_expires=2026-04-15, notes="manual grant by sara_support — original hold due to ip_velocity (mobile NAT)"
```

sara_support: Done. Notified customer and credited trial. :white_check_mark:

mike_eng: Thanks — I'll open a ticket to tune the fraud rule: reduce ip_velocity weight when email domain has MX and domain age > 180d. Also add a signal to ignore common mobile-carrier ASNs in APAC.

risk-bot: ticket FRAUD-2142 created and assigned to eng-ml for rule tuning.

linda_cs: Customer confirmed they can access trial and run the onboarding flow. Closing here. :tada:

sara_support: Added internal note to acct_009999 and flagged for monitoring for 72h.

mike_eng: ETA to tune rule ~3 business days. Will post updates in #eng-ml.

sara_support: Thanks team.
